note: Budget for `pnpm check:renders` (CI). Per scenario of tests/measure/renders.measure.ts: the exact number of `update:query` events the consumer applies, and the most re-renders the table's own components may do (`libraryUpdates`). Counts are deterministic, so the budget equals the count measured in 2.2.9 (filter fell from 50 to 26 when the header got stable slots). v3 (PR-C) raised filter from 26 to 34: the filter draft is table state in the TanStack store (`filterInputFeature`), so each of the six keys re-renders the four filter cells (6 x 4 = 24) and Enter adds 10. The root and the header read `canClearAll` through a computed, which keeps them out of that (an earlier measurement, 44, had `QueryTable` and `table-body` re-render with every key too); the other scenarios are unchanged. 3.1 (PR-D1) added move: ArrowRight on a reorder handle with the order written back re-renders the root, the header and the body once and the four filter cells once each (they read the column layout), 7 in all. 3.3 (change flash, ADR 0011) added live and flash: two live changes under the same query over 100 rows (a row at the top, three rows with a new age), once with `flash` off and once on. Both are 14: the root, the body, the header and the four filter cells once per change, so a flash re-renders nothing more; the marks are written by the body's own render of the new rows. The other scenarios are unchanged. Raise it only on purpose, in the change that adds the renders.
